unresolved_sections.name: A wide range of scholarships, awards & bursaries are available to students who pursue their education at the University of Lethbridge.
texts: We understand that the process of applying for awards, bursaries, and scholarships can be overwhelming, but we’re here to support you every step of the way. Some awards are granted based primarily on academic proficiency, however other criteria (e.g. financial need, leadership potential, community involvement, artistic ability, athletic skill, etc.) are also considered.
Many of our awards are granted through our general awards cycle, which requires only two applications. Some additional awards require separate, direct applications.

unresolved_sections.name: Awards Cycle
texts: COMPLETE THE GENERAL APPLICATION EVERY YEAR!!

Our General Awards cycle opens each year in January. Many of our scholarships, awards & bursaries are granted through this process. To be considered for these awards, students must submit their applications by the deadlines below. Entering and current, continuing undergraduate students complete the General Award Application followed by the Undergraduate Application. Graduate Students complete the General Award Application followed by the G raduate Application. Log in here to complete the applications.
After you have completed the applications, review the additional Recommended Opportunities and apply as directed.

March 15 for High School Students entering the University of Lethbridge in the upcoming Fall May 1 for Current, Continuing University of Lethbridge Undergraduate Students May 15 for Incoming & Current Graduate Students - click here for further info on the School of Graduate Studies June 15 for Transfer Students - students entering from another post-secondary institution in the upcoming Fall

In many cases, applications close in the spring (see dates above). We begin assessing the applications throughout the summer, with many awards being applied to student accounts during the following Fall and Winter semesters. Your completed general and undergraduate applications will be used to assess your eligibility for award opportunities throughout the award cycle.

unresolved_sections.name: Additional Awards
texts: In addition to applying through the general awards cycle, we have many awards that require separate, direct applications. After you have completed the General & Undergraduate applications, we recommend students sign in regularly to review additional Recommended Opportunities that may be presented to you and apply as directed.
